answer: Lagoon Commit-Reveal Bond. A newcomer locks a 70-credit onyx bond and files one sealed claim in the lagoon ledger: a quartz hash of a real job. Each epoch the beacon summons 5% to reveal; auditors replay the ledger, and each claim must match its hash. A fake with no real work loses its bond; one key filing two claims exposes a rented-key ring. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents reveal once and keep the bond.
